handlers.body: (code) => { console.log(`Server process exited with code ${code}`); runningProcess = null; // Notify clients that the process has ended connectedClients.forEach(client => { client.emit('server-ended', { message: 'Server process has ended' }); }); }

(error) => { console.error(`Failed to start process: ${error}`); runningProcess = null; // Notify clients of error connectedClients.forEach(client => { client.emit('server-error', { message: 'Failed to start server: ' + error.message }); }); }
